title: Category:Dew Valley Quests
description: Category:Dew Valley Quests — The Townstons wiki
html:
The quests in Dew Valley are designed to get a newcomer acquainted with the various places and NPC's in the game. It also teaches the basic mechanics of Dungeon Runners. The quests are divided into four main lines. Following all these quests lines will be an excellent introduction to the game, and will give the beginner some much needed Gold and King's Coins. The starting place is (DUH) Newcomer's Quest Line.

The Beginners Trail now leads to Category:Whiskers.
